jobs_results.title: Senior Back-end Software Engineer - PHP, Platform team (Remote...
jobs_results.description:
The Company

Printify is a high-growth, print-on-demand platform that connects e-commerce merchants and print-on-demand manufacturers. We work in a fast-paced and ever-developing industry with endless growth opportunities.

James Berdigans, Founder and Executive Chairman of Printify:

“Our mission is to build a platform that lets anyone, anywhere unlock their own personal freedom. The freedom to generate income, be your own boss, and set your schedule. So far we’ve seen more than 6 million people sign up to start their own eCommerce businesses with Printify. Because every order is made on-demand, there’s no risk to getting started, just reward for putting in the work. Our aim is to put this power to build a business into the hands of every person who wants to create their own business.”

The team

We transform business dreams into awesome digital products within our team of 24 different squads. Printify strives for excellence with engineering squads devoted to each platform component... resulting in sustainable, clean code and minimized technical debt. We’re looking for a Senior Back-End Software Engineer to join our Engineering Productivity squad, which is leveraging cutting-edge technology to optimize engineering processes and deliver high-quality products with efficiency. The team is committed to fostering a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and collaboration, ensuring the development process is streamlined and efficient. They are dedicated to enhancing productivity by implementing automation and providing Printify's engineers with the best tools and training available to excel and deliver exceptional value to Printify's customers.

The technology we use
• PHP 8+, Symfony, Doctrine, Laravel framework
• Jenkins, Prometheus, Grafana
• PHPUnit, Postman
• MongoDB, MySQL
• AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Git
• We also use practices such as Pair Programming, Refactoring, Code Reviews, Weekly Knowledge Sharing sessions, DDD/TDD/BDD, CQRS, A/B testing, and Continuous Delivery which are an important part of our development process

Your responsibilities:
• Build and maintain core platform components, services, internal APIs and systems that serve Printify engineering staff
• Solve technical problems of high scope and complexity
• Help identify areas of improvements in the codebase and help contribute to making it better
• Participate in pair programming, code refactoring and reviews, knowledge sharing sessions, and testing
• Develop skills by applying best practices and technologies
• Contribute to the company’s engineering culture

We expect you to have:
• At least 5 years of proven work experience in roles like Senior Engineer
• Strong knowledge of PHP
• Experience with AWS
• Solid understanding of object-oriented design and patterns
• Understaning of design principles and development practices
• Excellent written & spoken communication skills in English

It would be a bonus if you have:
• Previous experience working in Platform team
• Experience with continuous integration systems
• Experience with Infrastructure-as-code
• Experience with NodeJS/TypeScript

What we offer:
• Stock options, so you’ll own a part of Printify
• Opportunity to work fully remotely within EMEA time zones
• Work from anywhere – our Printify Houses in Riga or Tallinn, your remote home office, or a co-working space
• Start your workday anywhere between 7 AM and 11 AM
• Apple MacBook laptop as your standard work equipment
• International relocation support for candidates who want to work in Riga or Tallinn
• Access to mentorship, internal meetups, and hackathons both on-site and online
• A learning budget for your professional development and access to our book library
• Health insurance or a budget for it, depending on your location and contract
• Paid health days whenever you need them without a doctor's note, depending on your contract
• Extra paid days off for well-being, as well as a celebration day of your choice
• Access to the in-house gym or gym allowance, depending on your location and contract

Joining Printify means joining an international company with an amazing team that has grown to over 700 people. At Printify, people from over 20 nationalities and with many different backgrounds work together in our Riga office and worldwide.

We play to win together, and we always strive for excellence. We want to achieve great things and make a meaningful change in our customers’ lives. Our customers are our most important asset and our compass in showing us the direction to go. We value a strong learning culture and are united by a growth mindset.

At Printify, we are committed to fostering a diverse, fair, and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, age, disability, or any other grounds

jobs_results.title: PHP Developer
jobs_results.description:
En Walters People, estamos buscando activamente un Programador Senior para incorporarse al equipo de desarrollo de backend de uno de nuestros clientes principales. Este equipo lidera la revolución digital en diversas empresas, fomentando la innovación y maximizando la eficiencia a través de soluciones tecnológicas avanzadas.

Esta posición requiere que trabajes exclusivamente desde las oficinas en Barcelona.

Responsabilidades:
• Desarrollar y mantener aplicaciones backend de alto rendimiento.
• Colaborar estrechamente con otros miembros del equipo para diseñar, implementar y mantener soluciones técnicas.
• Optimizar la funcionalidad y el rendimiento de las aplicaciones existentes.
• Participar en la revisión de código y en la resolución de problemas técnicos.
• Integrar y administrar bases de datos relacionales, especialmente MySQL.
• Utilizar sistemas de control de versiones para gestionar el código fuente de manera efectiva.

Requisitos:
• Experiencia demostrable en desarrollo... backend, con un enfoque principal en PHP.
• Conocimiento sólido de bases de datos relacionales, preferiblemente MySQL.
• Experiencia en el desarrollo de aplicaciones móviles es altamente valorada.
• Competencia en inglés, preferiblemente a nivel avanzado.
• Habilidades para trabajar de manera colaborativa en un entorno ágil y orientado a resultados.
• Capacidad para adaptarse rápidamente a nuevas tecnologías y metodologías.

Se Ofrece:
• Jornada intensiva los viernes y durante el verano, promoviendo el equilibrio entre el trabajo y la vida personal.
• Ambiente colaborativo y dinámico, con oficinas ubicadas en el centro de Barcelona.
• Planes de formación continua y oportunidades de desarrollo profesional.
• Programa de onboarding estructurado para una integración exitosa en el equipo

jobs_results.title: FULLSTACK DEVELOPER BACK-END FIRST
jobs_results.description:
Buscamos a un profesional con pasión por la tecnología y un enfoque práctico en el desarrollo de backend.

Deberás tener:
• Experiencia avanzada en desarrollo backend: Profundo conocimiento en Python, FastAPI, y Express, con al menos 2-3 años de experiencia en desarrollo backend, incluyendo la implementación de aplicaciones en entornos de producción.
• Creación y consumo de API Rest: Experiencia en el desarrollo y uso de API REST y adopción del enfoque “API First”.
• Arquitectura y diseño de software: Conocimientos en arquitectura hexagonal/limpia y Diseño Dirigido por el Dominio (DDD).
• Gestión de bases de datos complejas: Experiencia en la gestión y optimización de bases de datos relacionales (MySQL, PostgreSQL) y NoSQL (MongoDB), incluyendo bases de datos geolocalizadas y de series temporales.
• Prácticas avanzadas de desarrollo y testing: Experiencia en implementar prácticas de desarrollo de código limpio, SOLID, TDD, y CI/CD utilizando herramientas como Docker y Kubernetes.
•... Integración de tecnologías emergentes: Experiencia en la integración de tecnologías emergentes como GIS, IIoT, IoT, y ML/DL para fortalecer el producto…

Formación académica:

Grado superior en Ingeniería Informática o titulación similar.

Idiomas:

Nivel alto de inglés.

Experiencia:

Mínimo 2-3 años de experiencia como desarrollador back-end.

¡Si buscas un desafío apasionante en el mundo IT, envíanos tu currículum ahora y únete a nuestro equipo de profesionales líderes en el sector

jobs_results.title: Senior Software Engineer - Back End
jobs_results.description:
Why you should join dLocal?

dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest-growing, emerging markets.

By joining us you will be a part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen, in a flexible, remote-first dynamic culture with travel, health, and learning benefits, among others. Being a part of dLocal means working with 800+ teammates from 25+ different nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives. We are builders, we never run from a challenge, we are customer-centric, and if this sounds like you, we know you will thrive in our team.

What’s the opportunity?

As our Senior Java Developer you will build... high-performing, scalable, enterprise-grade applications. You will be part of a talented software team that works on mission-critical applications with big customers.

What will I be doing?
• Contribute in all phases of the development lifecycle
• Designing, developing and delivering high-volume, low-latency applications for mission-critical systems
• Write well designed, testable, efficient code
• Ensure designs are in compliance with specifications
• Support continuous improvement by investigating alternatives and technologies and presenting these for architectural review

What skills do I need?
• Proven hands-on Software Development experience
• Proven working experience in Java development
• Hands on experience in designing and developing applications using Java platforms
• Object Oriented analysis and design using common design patterns
• Profound insight of Java
• Experience in working/designing microservices
• Good knowledge of Relational Databases, SQL and ORM technologies (JPA2, Hibernate). NoSql knowledge is desirable
• Experience in Spring Framework
• Experience with test-driven development
• AWS knowledge is a plus
• Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git
• Written and spoken English
• Ability to work independently
• Be a team player

What happens after you apply?

Our Talent Acquisition team is invested in creating the best candidate experience possible, so don’t worry, you will definitely hear from us. We will review your CV and keep you posted by email at every step of the process!

Also, you can check out our webpage, Linkedin, Instagram, and Youtube for more about dLocal

jobs_results.title: Back-End Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
¿Quieres formar parte por fin de un proyecto estratégico y motivador?

Mirai: ¿quiénes somos?

Somos una empresa con más de 25 años de andadura que trabaja en exclusiva para los hoteles con el objetivo de llevar a su máximo potencial la venta directa. Ofrecemos tecnología, marketing digital y consultoría en distribución.

Tenemos actualmente oficinas en España, Francia, Portugal, México y USA.

Podríamos decir que “necesitamos una persona proactiva, decidida, meticulosa, curiosa, comunicativa, motivada y comprometida”. Pero creemos que es mejor que lo compruebes por tí mismo: ¿Este podrías ser tú?:
• Te gustan los retos y no tienes miedo a equivocarte.
• Te gusta inventar y poner en marcha proyectos nuevos. Eres dinámico y te gustan los cambios.
• Te gusta irte a casa cada día aprendiendo algo nuevo.
• Eres un jugador de equipo, te gusta celebrar las victorias y ayudar a tus compañeros cuando están en problemas.
• Te cuestionas si para cumplir un objetivo la decisión tomada es la... mejor. Y eres flexible: reaccionas, reconoces tus errores e intentas corregirlos.
• Te comprometes con tus tareas hasta el final, sin abandonarlas cuando se complican.
• Eres detallista, pero sabes priorizar y tienes foco para no perderte en los detalles.
• Eres empático, sabes escuchar y comunicar tienes una actitud de mejora continua, ganas e ilusión.

Y, en concreto, como ingeniero del SW, necesitamos que:
• Analizando varias cuestiones en diferentes lugares y momentos, seas capaz de encontrar un patrón.
• Te guste hacer una pequeña prueba aislada antes de seguir con el siguiente paso o aplicar a producción.
• Muestres interés en mejorar nuestro software/arquitectura/infraestructura aportando ideas o soluciones, sin limitarte a "copiar/pegar" lo que ya existe.
• Pruebes nuevas soluciones tecnológicas, pero si las utilizas en nuestro producto, sea siempre con justificación.
• Consideras que las herramientas, entorno, lenguajes de programación, aplicaciones, metodologías y tecnologías son solo medios para llegar al objetivo, y, por tanto, pueden cambiar de uno a otro.
• Tienes no solo capacidad para buscar una solución teórica, sino también de implementarla.
• Además es necesario que puedas comunicarte en inglés con fluidez.

Si eres así, nos interesa conocerte.

¿Qué harás?

Entre nuestros productos tenemos un motor de reservas online que es referente en la industria, integrado con los Metabuscadores de precios más conocidos del sector (Google, TripAdvisor, Trivago, Kayak, SkyScanner). Desarrollamos APIs para que terceras empresas, colaboradoras de nuestros clientes, puedan consumir nuestros datos de manera rápida y precisa.

También nos integramos con diversas pasarelas de pago con el fin de facilitar al hotel el poder cobrar parcial o totalmente sus reservas en el momento en que sus clientes las realizan.

Las tecnologías que actualmente utilizamos son:
• Java 11, Spring Boot
• PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis
• RabbitMQ

Trabajamos con la nube de Amazon y nuestras aplicaciones funcionan sobre Kubernetes. Somos una empresa muy dinámica, como nuestro sector, y nos apoyamos en metodologías ágiles desde hace 15 años.

No queremos vivir del pasado y presente, sino de un futuro prometedor en la industria turística. Hay un recorrido infinito en la utilización de la tecnología en el sector hotelero (Big Data, IoT, nuevos lenguajes más eficientes, bases de datos NoSQL,...) y queremos recorrer ese camino con personas como tú. Como Ingeniero de SW de Mirai, nos ayudarás a conseguirlo.

¿Qué ofrecemos?
• Posibilidad de trabajar desde cualquiera de las oficinas de Mirai de Albufeira, Benidorm, Barcelona, Gijón, Madrid, Palma de Mallorca o París… o teletrabajar desde cualquier lugar en el mundo.
• Trabajamos en un entorno distendido, dinámico y multidisciplinar, y nos esforzamos porque fluya el talento, ser profesionales y fomentar la responsabilidad individual.
• Puesto estable.
• Horario atractivo (L a J de 08 a 17hs y V de 08 a 15. Jornada intensiva en verano durante 3 meses).
• Conciliación familiar REAL: nuestra empresa, con una plantilla joven, pero de gran experiencia, siempre ha estado muy concienciada con las necesidades de conciliación familiar de sus empleados, facilitando desde hace años el trabajo en remoto y ofreciendo cierta flexibilidad horaria.
• Ambiente de trabajo cercano y familiar.
• Las oficinas, ubicadas en el centro de las ciudades, y todas ellas diáfanas, disponen de todo lo necesario para hacer que tu día sea más agradable.
• Trabajamos para vivir y no al contrario.
• Equipo de trabajo joven y experimentado.
• Participación en proyecto estratégico.
• Remuneración salarial en función de tu valía.

¡TE ESPERAMOS

Entre nuestros productos tenemos un motor de reservas online que es referente en la industria, integrado con los Metabuscadores de precios más conocidos del sector (Google, TripAdvisor, Trivago, Kayak, SkyScanner). Desarrollamos APIs para que terceras empresas, colaboradoras de nuestros clientes, puedan consumir nuestros datos de manera rápida y precisa.

También nos integramos con diversas pasarelas de pago con el fin de facilitar al hotel el poder cobrar parcial o totalmente sus reservas en el momento en que sus clientes las realizan.

Las tecnologías que actualmente utilizamos son:
• Java 11, Spring Boot
• PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis
• RabbitMQ

Trabajamos con la nube de Amazon y nuestras aplicaciones funcionan sobre Kubernetes. Somos una empresa muy dinámica, como nuestro sector, y nos apoyamos en metodologías ágiles desde hace 15 años.

No queremos vivir del pasado y presente, sino de un futuro prometedor en la industria turística. Hay un recorrido infinito en la utilización de la tecnología en el sector hotelero (Big Data, IoT, nuevos lenguajes más eficientes, bases de datos NoSQL,...) y queremos recorrer ese camino con personas como tú. Como Ingeniero de SW de Mirai, nos ayudarás a conseguirlo.

¿Qué ofrecemos?
• Posibilidad de trabajar desde cualquiera de las oficinas de Mirai de Albufeira, Benidorm, Barcelona, Gijón, Madrid, Palma de Mallorca o París… o teletrabajar desde cualquier lugar en el mundo.
• Trabajamos en un entorno distendido, dinámico y multidisciplinar, y nos esforzamos porque fluya el talento, ser profesionales y fomentar la responsabilidad individual.
• Puesto estable.
• Horario atractivo (L a J de 08 a 17hs y V de 08 a 15. Jornada intensiva en verano durante 3 meses).
• Conciliación familiar REAL: nuestra empresa, con una plantilla joven, pero de gran experiencia, siempre ha estado muy concienciada con las necesidades de conciliación familiar de sus empleados, facilitando desde hace años el trabajo en remoto y ofreciendo cierta flexibilidad horaria.
• Ambiente de trabajo cercano y familiar.
• Las oficinas, ubicadas en el centro de las ciudades, y todas ellas diáfanas, disponen de todo lo necesario para hacer que tu día sea más agradable.
• Trabajamos para vivir y no al contrario.
• Equipo de trabajo joven y experimentado.
• Participación en proyecto estratégico.
• Remuneración salarial en función de tu valía.

¡TE ESPERAMOS

jobs_results.title: Backend Software Architect (Python)
Back End Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
TUI Group is the world’s number one integrated tourism business. Flight Production and Logistics is a global team within TUI technology responsible for airline reservation and passenger data. We enable TUI airlines to realise the most innovative and reliable flight products, ancillary services and passenger logistics IT solutions for our customers. We are a multi-disciplinary team of experts across Architecture, Engineering, DevOps and Agile Delivery providing services across the UK, Ireland, Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, Germany, Belgium and The Netherlands.

At TUI we’re ambitious to become the leader in technology within the travel industry and to achieve this we are looking to build a capable, creative team who want to be a part of accomplishing that goal.

 

We never stop looking ahead, seeking new ways to delight our customers and grow our business. We recognise the power of digital and the massive contribution this brings to creating a truly unique and differentiated... customer experience. 

 

We are looking for a talented and dedicated technical enthusiast to join our Flight Production & Passenger Logistics team.

 

The Back End Software Engineer is a practitioner and an advocate of state-of-the-art software development practices, developing software products with a broad toolkit of technologies and methods and with a strong DevOps mindset, being able to tackle the whole software development cycle of designing, building, testing and deploying applications. Working in an agile environment and keeping up with the ever-evolving technical landscape the Back End Software Engineer is a lifelong learner and likes to think outside the box.

ABOUT THE JOB:

As a Back End Software Engineer, you will be part of a cross-functional team or a practice team that enables software development skills and capabilities across a whole domain. Together with your team you will own the software products from conception to operation. Being an enthusiast in software engineering and software craftsmanship, with a strong DevSecOps mindset, and thanks to your excellent collaboration skills you will support your team in delivering the best answers to our customers’ needs and in taking over full responsibility for its applications, from design to operation.

You will strive for a high degree of automation, clean architectures and high quality with a customer-centric mindset. You are able to select the right tools for the right jobs and thus solve the given business and technical problems in an efficient way. You show a commercial mentality, focusing on solving business problems in the best way. You will work in a cloud environment, especially AWS, and develop resilient and high-performing cloud-native applications. You have a good understanding of the AWS toolbox, leveraging AWS services and cloud design patterns in a micro-service landscape. You can tackle the whole cycle of designing, building, testing and deploying software and contribute to increasing automation. Also Security is part of everyone’s job. At TUI, we practise secure behaviours first in everything we do. 

You are able to verbalise your thoughts and ideas and take the initiative to translate ideas into outcomes. Together with the domain’s Practice teams as well as the Group Enabler teams you also will research, evaluate and test new approaches, processes and tools and help teams to use them effectively.

You love to work in an international, multi-cultural team. You challenge constructively and have high expectations of yourself and others. You always drive for technical excellence, ownership and self-organisation at team and personal level.  You love to learn and acquire new skills and keep up to date with latest developments in your focus areas.

ABOUT YOU:
• You have a completed technical degree (e.g. computer science, business informatics) or a comparable qualification. 
• You have experience in the further development of products and services and in the implementation of customer requirements.  
• You have very good knowledge of .Net C# as well as relevant frameworks and concepts, such as .Net and Core, REST, MVC and Microservices.  
• You have good knowledge of MS SQL and MySQL database.  
• You feel conﬁdent in using Visual Studio and NUnit & Mocking frameworks (e.g. Moq) You have experience in creating modern ASP.NET applications. 
• You know about Gitlab and AWS CodePipeline (CloudFormation).
• You have a very good command of English (written and spoken).  
• You are familiar with Agile software development and DevOps and have worked with these before.
• You are a team player and love to find solutions for complex problems in a joint fashion. 
• You have first experiences and knowledge on agile ways of working (e.g. Scrum, Kanban) and want to take responsibility for steadily improving the work processes and interaction within the team. 

OUR OFFER:
• Being a valuable team member of TUI, the No.1 global and socially aware travel company.
• Competitive salary and benefits.
• Smart working (Flexible hours) and possibility of working remotely up to 100% or Hybrid from one of our offices.
• Develop yourself as part of a friendly, richly, diverse and virtual international team.

If you want to know more about why TUI Group is the world's leading tourism group, and our continuing work in the diversity & inclusion space, simply visit careers.tuigroup.com

jobs_results.title: Senior Back-end Software Engineer - PHP (Remote within EMEA)
jobs_results.description:
The Company

Printify is a high-growth, print-on-demand platform that connects e-commerce merchants and print-on-demand manufacturers. We work in a fast-paced and ever-developing industry with endless growth opportunities.

James Berdigans, Founder and Executive Chairman of Printify:

“Our mission is to build a platform that lets anyone, anywhere unlock their own personal freedom. The freedom to generate income, be your own boss, and set your schedule. So far we’ve seen more than 6 million people sign up to start their own eCommerce businesses with Printify. Because every order is made on-demand, there’s no risk to getting started, just reward for putting in the work. Our aim is to put this power to build a business into the hands of every person who wants to create their own business.”

The team

We are looking for a Senior Back-end Software Engineer to join our growing Engineering team.

We transform business dreams into awesome digital products. We do this magic through 21 loosely... coupled squads - each specializing in their own area of expertise. These include, but are not limited to, Demand Integrations, Growth, Order, Payments, Supply, and Product Presentation. Printify is a true product company. Each engineering squad works on its own product or area of expertise tirelessly. This yields sustainable, clean code along with less technical debt.

The role

As a back-end engineer, you will play a key role in shaping and delivering a scalable and robust solution. You will be part of the team to bring quality and scalability to the product setup process and tools to a new level, you will follow the best practices in DDD and CQRS.

Passion for writing and improving (clean) code and systems, being a team player with a collaborative approach, sharing knowledge, and humbly learning from others are essential to succeed in this position. Developing in this role will give you the opportunity to grow and move up within the company.

The technology we use
• PHP 8+, Symfony, Doctrine, Laravel framework
• Jenkins, Prometheus, Grafana
• PHPUnit, Postman
• MongoDB, MySQL
• AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Git
• We also use practices such as Pair Programming, Refactoring, Code Reviews, Weekly Knowledge Sharing sessions, TDD/BDD, A/B testing, and Continuous Delivery which are an important part of our development process

Minimum Qualifications
• Good level of English (spoken and written)
• 5+ years of experience with PHP
• Experience with DDD (Domain-Driven Design)
• Quality-oriented: follow best practices (Testing (ideally TDD), continuous integration/deployment, Agile methodologies) and SOLID principles

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with CQRS (Command Query Responsibility Segregation)
• Experience in architecting new systems or refactoring legacy systems

What to expect as a Back-end Engineer at Printify
• You will work alongside the product teams and product managers to iterate on new features within Printify
• You will take responsibility for the design and execution of your own initiatives
• You will help identify areas of improvement in the codebase and help contribute to making it better
• You will frequently pair with teammates to give and receive feedback from a code review to boost knowledge-sharing, and learning and improve the platform
• You will fix any prioritized bugs/issues tracked within the platform
• You will participate as a presenter or attendee, in weekly coding or knowledge-sharing sessions
• You will learn, develop your soft skills and spend time discussing best practices and technologies with your peers

What we offer
• Stock options so you own a part of Printify
• Opportunity to work fully remote within EMEA time zones
• Work from anywhere - our Printify Houses in Riga or Tallinn, your remote home office, or a co-working hub
• Start your workday anywhere between 7 AM and 11 AM. As long as the job is done and you’re happy and healthy, you can adapt your workflow.
• Apple MacBook laptop as your standard work equipment, covered by Printify
• International relocation support for international candidates who wish to work in Riga or Tallinn
• Access to mentorship, internal meetups, and hackathons both on-site and online
• A learning budget for your professional development based on a position level and access to our book library
• Health insurance or health insurance budget depending on your location and contract type
• Paid health days whenever you need them without a doctor's note depending on your contract type
• Extra paid days off for wellbeing as well as a celebration day of your choosing
• Access to the in-house gym or gym allowance depending on your location and contract type

Our team
• Printifyers come from more than 20 countries
• Our team has grown to more than 600 team members (and growing!)
• We are the 15th America’s fastest-growing company in 2020 (Financial Times

jobs_results.title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
ABOUT STRANDS

Strands is a leading fintech company at the forefront of innovation in the financial industry. Our cutting-edge solutions empower banks and financial institutions to deliver personalized and intelligent banking experiences. Our products are fully embedded with Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning capabilities so joining us is a great opportunity to be at the forefront of this new revolution.

With more than 100 employees worldwide we still work as a startup. Since 2020 we are part of the CRIF group, a world leader in the Financial Sector. So we have the best of both worlds, we operate as a startup and we are backed by a big company!

ABOUT THE ROLE

Love the smell of fresh code in the morning? Are you a passionate developer and a need to be challenged? Do you want to be part of a team that develops innovative and lasting product?

Strands is waiting for you! You will join our Engineering Team and help design and develop an innovative FinTech software that... enables banks to offer personalised digital banking experiences.

Reporting to the Backend Technical Lead, the candidate will work on the development of sophisticated and innovative backend solutions in a fast-paced, dynamic and international team.

You will do things like...
• Design the architecture of our platform with our Backend Architect
• Programming highly-available software and innovative functionality
• Work with Kafka and other messaging systems
• Analyse requirements and solutions to provide the best software experience.
• Troubleshooting and issue resolution.
• Understanding of Java server-side technologies.

You'll do it using your...
• Compelling working experience in a Java 8/JEE/Kotlin/Scala back-end environment (preferably using Agile / Scrum methodology)
• Excellent knowledge of SOLID principles and design patterns
• Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and why they are important
• Build reliable, highly available, and scalable software on top of streaming platforms like Kafka/ AMQP / Google Pub/Sub technologies.
• Developing REST-based APIs.
• Experience in SQL/NoSQL technologies

You'll love it because you will get...
• Competitive salary;
• Private health care insurance;
• Gym free pass;
• Meal vouchers;
• Subscription to unlimited online training courses by Udemy;
• Flexible working hours;
• Snacks and food, Fresh organic fruit, drinks, tea, coffee and juices;
• Cutting-edge technologies;
• Hybrid model of working from home and office attendance.

Don’t hesitate to apply even if you are not sure to cover all requirements, we would love to see your profile
